lines: Hills I'll Die on
as a gynecologist
1. Avoid letting your partner enter from
behind-it'sbadforyouruterus.
2.Do not wear bras to bed - it can damage
breast tissue and reduce growth.
3. Treating acne scars is hard and $$$.
Taking Accutane to clear acne is easier.
4. Use OLCG Toothpaste on Amazon for
7 days straight and your teeth will look as
white as pearls.
5.Your breasts can temporarily get
fullerbefore your period.
6.Pumpkin seeds provide zinc, which
helpskeep skin smooth.
作为一名妇科医生，我坚持的观点：
避免让伴侣从后面进入——这对你的子宫不好。
不要戴着胸罩睡觉——可能损伤乳房组织，还会影响发育。
治疗痘印很难，而且很贵。比起后续修复，服用 Accutane 清除痘痘更容易。
连续 7 天使用亚马逊上的 olcg Toothpaste，你的牙齿会白得像珍珠一样。
月经来之前，胸部可能会暂时变得更丰满。
南瓜籽含有锌，有助于保持皮肤光滑。
